pages.name: Larvae
pages.text: It builds its cocoon from what it finds.
A larva picks up materials lying within a block and a half, one every few seconds, up to four.$(br2)Each material colours a segment of its cocoon.
$(item)It collects$()$(br)Diamond, glowstone dust, lapis lazuli, emerald, iron nugget, redstone, obsidian, netherite scrap, prismarine shard, copper ingot, echo shard.
An adult larva drops a caddisfly cocoon with its materials when killed, and keeps them when caught.$(br2)Flowers breed larvae. The Collector villager deals in cocoons.
